description: This file defines a class 'SheetViews' used to parse and load sheet view settings such as zoom, gridlines, headers, view type, pane freeze, and selection from an XML representation in an XLSX spreadsheet. It configures display and view properties for a worksheet in a spreadsheet processing library.

classes.name: SheetViews
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing and applying sheet view settings from an XML element, including zoom, view type, gridlines, headers, pane freeze, and cell selection.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SheetViews instance with the XML data and worksheet to configure.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads various view settings such as top-left cell, zoom, view, gridlines, headers, direction, zeros, pane freeze, and selection from the XML.

methods.name: zoomScale
methods.description: Sets the zoom scale and normal zoom scale for the worksheet view based on XML attributes.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Sets the worksheet view type (e.g., page layout, normal) from XML attributes.

methods.name: topLeft
methods.description: Defines the top-left cell for the worksheet view from XML attributes.

methods.name: gridLines
methods.description: Sets whether grid lines are shown based on XML attributes.

methods.name: headers
methods.description: Sets whether row and column headers are shown based on XML attributes.

methods.name: direction
methods.description: Sets the right-to-left display mode based on XML attributes.

methods.name: showZeros
methods.description: Defines whether zeros are displayed in the worksheet view based on XML attributes.

methods.name: pane
methods.description: Sets the freeze pane position based on pane XML attributes.

methods.name: selection
methods.description: Sets the selected cells based on the selection XML element.
